description: Autocomplete combobox with filtering, keyboard navigation, and native form association

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Require a selection for form validation

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the input and tag remove buttons, closes the listbox and drops the value from submission. A disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect.

attributes.name: custom
attributes.description: Allow typed entries via Enter/comma (multi mode)

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected when the listbox is open

structure.description: Text input for filtering and display. Give it an id and point a <label for> at it — the id and labels are preserved and name the combobox.
Individual option — one per selectable choice

childAttributes.name: data-value
childAttributes.description: Option value identifier placed on each <li> in the options list

childAttributes.name: name
childAttributes.description: Submission name for the no-JS fallback (submits the typed text). Moved to the host on upgrade (the host's own name wins if both are set).

events.name: combo-box:change
events.detail: { value, label, source } | { values[], labels[], source }
events.description: Fired when selection changes. source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'internal' for user picks. Re-choosing the current option closes the list without firing.
